sentences.en: D Early cinema audiences often experienced the same confusion.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In time, the idea of film became familiar, the magic was accepted — but it never stopped being magic.
sentences.zh: 电影的概念逐渐为人所熟知,魔法被接受——但它从未停止成为魔法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Film has never lost its unique power to embrace its audiences and transport them to a different world.
sentences.zh: 电影从未失去其独特的力量, 来拥抱观众, 并将观众传送到不同的世界。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: For Tarkovsky, the key to that magic was the way in which cinema created a dynamic image of the real flow of events.
sentences.zh: 对于塔尔夫斯基来说, 魔法的关键在于电影如何创造出一个动态的图像来反映事件的真正流动。

sentences.en: A still picture could only imply the existence of time, while time in a novel passed at the whim of the reader but in cinema, the real, objective flow of time was captured.
sentences.zh: 静态画面只能意味着时间的存在,而小说中的时间在读者的意想不到的瞬间通过,但在电影中,真实客观的时间流却被记录下来。

sentences.en: E One effect of this realism was to educate the world about itself.
sentences.zh: 这种现实主义的一个效果是教育世界了解自身。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: For cinema makes the world smaller.

sentences.en: Long before people travelled to America or anywhere else, they knew what other places looked like; they knew how other people worked and lived.
sentences.zh: 早在人们前往美国或其他地方之前,他们就知道其他地方是什么样子;他们知道其他人是如何工作和生活的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Overwhelmingly, the lives recorded – at least in film fiction – have been American.
sentences.zh: 最令人感到沮丧的是,记录的生命 — — 至少是在电影小说中 — — 一直是美国人。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: From the earliest days of the industry, Hollywood has dominated the world film market.
sentences.zh: 从最初的电影业开始,好莱坞就主宰了世界电影市场。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: American imagery – the cars, the cities, the cowboys – became the primary imagery of film.
sentences.zh: 美国形象 — — 汽车、城市、牛仔 — — 成为电影的主要形象。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Film carried American life and values around the globe.
sentences.zh: 电影中美国的生活和价值观遍布全球。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: F And, thanks to film, future generations will know the 20th century more intimately than any other period.
sentences.zh: F,由于电影, 后代将比其他任何时期更熟悉20世纪。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: We can only imagine what life was like in the 14th century or in classical Greece.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: But the life of the modern world has been recorded on film in massive, encyclopedic detail.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.zh: 我们比前世更为人所知。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: G The ‘star’ was another natural consequence of cinema.
sentences.zh: G `星辰 ' 是电影的另一个自然结果。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Film personalities have such an immediate presence that, inevitably, they become super-real.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Because we watch them so closely and because everybody in the world seems to bow who they are, they appear more real to us than we do ourselves.

sentences.en: Almost unbelievably, it is a mere 100 years since that train arrived and the audience screamed and fled, convinced by the dangerous reality of what they saw, and, perhaps, suddenly aware that the world could never be the same again – that, maybe, it could be better, brighter, more astonishing, more real than reality.
sentences.zh: 几乎令人难以置信的是,距离火车到达和观众尖叫和逃离仅仅100年,他们相信他们所看到的危险现实,也许突然意识到世界将永远不会再一样 — — 也许,这比现实更好、更光明、更惊人、更真实、更真实。
